name: Mandarin Oriental, Jakarta
positioning: City hotel on Jalan M.H. Thamrin in central Jakarta, surrounded by shopping malls, with views of the Welcome Monument
best_for: Travelers who want a central Jakarta base within walking distance of Plaza Indonesia and Grand Indonesia
Guests who want a spa rooted in Javanese massage

facts.text: Mandarin Oriental, Jakarta is located at Jalan M.H. Thamrin, Jakarta.
Mandarin Oriental, Jakarta is surrounded by world-class shopping malls.
Mandarin Oriental, Jakarta offers stunning views of the iconic Welcome Monument.
Plaza Indonesia is a 4-5 minute walk from the hotel.
Grand Indonesia is a 5 minute walk from the hotel.
Cinnamon is an all-day dining restaurant serving Indonesian flavours.
MO Bar offers creative cocktails, mocktails, and small bites.
Azure is a tropical poolside bar with a kids' menu.
The Mandarin Oriental Cake Shop serves freshly baked pastries and delicacies.

highlights.text: The Spa combines Javanese massage techniques with Chinese meridian theory.
The Mandarin Oriental Club Lounge is located on the 21st floor.
The Club Lounge overlooks the iconic Welcome Monument.
The outdoor swimming pool overlooks a modern LED screen and Jakarta's skyscrapers.
The Gym is equipped with Technogym equipment.

considerations.text: The Mandarin Oriental Club Lounge is exclusively reserved for guests aged 16 and above from Monday to Thursday.
The minimum age requirement for access to Fitness & Wellness is 16 years old.
The journey from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport typically takes 30-60 minutes, depending on traffic.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a busy business district with heavy traffic.
